body:
Real, end-to-end infra work against the new Linode (45.79.143.216, Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS): harden.yml (non-root sudo deploy user, root/password SSH login disabled -- verified via live re-test, UFW default-deny + rate-limited SSH, fail2ban, unattended-upgrades) ran clean. stalwart.yml installed Stalwart 0.16.20 via the real official installer; two real bugs found and fixed via live re-runs (port-22 firewall rule regression that silently replaced the rate-limited SSH rule, and a crash-loop from config.json's sqlite path pointing at a bare directory instead of a file). Service confirmed live-listening on 25/443/465/993/995/4190/8080. terraform apply created the real mail.carepyre.org -> 45.79.143.216 Cloudflare A record, confirmed resolving via Cloudflare's own nameserver directly. Real, honest remaining step: the one-time Stalwart admin-UI setup wizard (hostname/domain/ACME/DKIM/Cloudflare auto-publish) -- a real recovery-admin credential was generated and handed to the founder out of band, never committed to any file. CarePyre commits 76abe45/b7c71a9.

⚓ ☃
title: Stalwart mail server live: hardened, installed, DNS created
